name: idx_wallet_tx_tournament_receipts_cover
definition: CREATE INDEX idx_wallet_tx_tournament_receipts_cover ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (related_entity_id) INCLUDE (type, category, amount) WHERE ((related_entity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (((type = 'debit'::text) AND (category = ANY (ARRAY['tournament_buyin'::text, 'rebuy'::text, 'addon'::text]))) OR ((type = 'credit'::text) AND (category = ANY (ARRAY['refund'::text, 'prize'::text, 'bounty'::text])))))
predicate: related_entity_id IS NOT NULL AND ((type = 'debit' AND category IN ('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon')) OR (type = 'credit' AND category IN ('refund','prize','bounty')))
